account: Completed on first pass. Built a three-node flightpath for the publish-post program: publishPost (handler) calls renderHtml (pure) and uploadHtml (io). renderHtml throws BadMarkdown which publishPost catches and handles with a fallback to plain text. uploadHtml retries on S3 failure. Two presets modeled happy path (valid markdown, retry succeeds) and bad markdown (parse fails, caught by handler, plain text uploads).
